label: Binary
smallDescription: Read, write and identify binary formats
description: Decode and encode binary data without Node.js Buffer: a bounds-checked byte reader and a growable byte writer for fixed-size integers and floats, LEB128 varints, NUL-terminated strings, and the zigzag mapping for signed varints. Also: hexadecimal output and media types, from the first bytes of an image or the extension of a path.
